title: Ignition Specifications — 2.3L EcoBoost
introduction:
The spark plug provides the controlled gap where coil voltage starts combustion. I use this EcoBoost sheet to read the plug entry and its specified gap together—the gap is a deliberate part of the ignition arrangement, not a tiny detail to eyeball and forget.

Read the gap in either of the printed inch and millimeter units. The Spark plug entry is an identifier as printed; this page alone does not establish a complete replacement ordering number. It also does not supply plug access, gap-adjustment instructions or installation torque.

edits.why: Use this table within the stated EcoBoost engine applicability. Keep the plug identifier separate from the gap dimension, and keep each dimension with its printed unit. The gap value is a specification, not an instruction to bend an electrode or a diagnosis of an ignition fault.
